pages.title: Three Actions Each Year
pages.text: Use Execute Annual Plan directly on the Life tab. The planner has three action slots and uses the same requirements as manual activities; unavailable activities are greyed out. Ordinary activities cost one action point, seclusion two, and seclusion is limited to once per year.

pages.title: Conditions and Recovery
pages.text: Each slot supports None, Any, Health, Strain, or Stability conditions. Unmet conditions, severe weakness, or excessive strain cause a recovery action instead. Awakening, a cultivation method, and sect membership are still required for their respective activities.

pages.title: Resolve Encounters First
pages.text: A story choice, breakthrough, battle, or blocking journey stops the plan. Resolve the encounter before continuing; the plan does not make story decisions for you. Completing the routine advances the year when allowed, restoring three action points for the new year.
